store.name: Flint
store.description: A small, considered collection of things to wear, carry, write with, build and keep.

categories.name: Wear
categories.description: Heavyweight basics, cut a little boxy and built to soften with every wash.

categories.name: Carry
categories.description: Bags and sleeves for the things you take between rooms and cities.

categories.name: Desk
categories.description: Tools for writing things down before they disappear.

categories.name: Home
categories.description: Things to drink from and light up at the end of a long day.

categories.name: Play
categories.description: Build sets, pins and stickers. Small objects with no job but joy.

products.name: Heavyweight Hoodie
products.summary: A 480gsm brushed fleece hoodie with a boxy body, dropped shoulders and a small embroidered spark on the chest.
details: Tonal embroidered spark on left chest
Garment dyed for a soft, lived-in hand
products.materials: 100% organic cotton. Knitted and garment dyed in Portugal.
products.care: Wash cold inside out. Hang dry. Pre-shrunk, but it still loves a low tumble.

products.name: Boxy Tee
products.summary: A dense 260gsm jersey tee with a cropped boxy cut and a tight ribbed collar that keeps its shape.
products.care: Wash cold. Tumble dry low. Iron inside out.

products.name: Loopback Crew
products.summary: An unbrushed loopback crewneck with a quiet embroidered wordmark. Lighter than the hoodie, made for in-between weather.
details: Regular fit, ribbed cuffs and hem
products.care: Wash cold inside out. Hang dry.

products.name: Six-Panel Cap
products.summary: An unstructured washed twill cap with a low crown and a spark stitched on the front.

products.name: Rib Beanie
products.summary: A chunky merino rib beanie with a deep cuff and a small woven label.
products.materials: 100% extra-fine merino wool. Knitted in Scotland.

products.name: Canvas Tote
products.summary: A 16oz canvas tote with long handles, an inside pocket and a small screen print near the base.
products.care: Spot clean or cold hand wash.

products.name: Felt Laptop Sleeve
products.summary: A thick wool felt sleeve with a leather pull tab. Fits most 13 and 14 inch laptops.
products.care: Brush clean. Keep leather away from water.

products.name: Machined Pen
products.summary: A weighty ballpoint turned from solid bar stock, with a knurled grip and a tiny engraved spark.
products.materials: Solid brass, or aluminum with black anodized finish.
products.care: Brass develops a patina. Polish to restore, or let it age.

products.name: Gel Pen Trio
products.summary: Three slim 0.5mm gel pens in the house colors. Smooth, quick-drying, refillable.

products.name: Lay-Flat Notebook
products.summary: An A5 dot-grid notebook with exposed binding, so every spread opens perfectly flat.

products.name: Felt Desk Mat
products.summary: A wide wool felt mat with a natural cork base. Quiet under a keyboard, soft under a forearm.

products.name: Stoneware Mug
products.summary: A thrown stoneware mug with a satin glaze and a raw clay foot. Holds a proper 350ml.
products.care: Dishwasher safe. Each piece varies slightly.

products.name: Insulated Bottle
products.summary: A 750ml double-wall steel bottle with a powder-coated finish. Cold for 24 hours, hot for 12.

products.name: Soy Candle
products.summary: A 220g soy candle with a crackling wooden wick. Two scents for the end of the day.
details: Ember: cedar, amber, smoked vanilla. Smoke: vetiver, black tea, birch tar
products.care: Trim the wick before each burn. Never leave unattended.

products.name: Build Set
products.summary: Interlocking brick builds designed in house. Start with the campfire, or go big with the two-storey studio.
details: Campfire: 214 pieces. Studio: 486 pieces with a light-up sign
products.materials: ABS plastic bricks, recycled card box.

products.name: Enamel Pin Set
products.summary: Four hard enamel pins with gold-plated outlines and double rubber clutches.

products.name: Sticker Sheet
products.summary: Ten die-cut vinyl stickers for laptops, bottles and notebooks.
